target_planning_window: before next likely Codex restart around 2026-06-05
goal: Prevent solved development problems from becoming unsolved problems after Codex thread loss, compaction, freeze, or restart.
problem_statement: MIM/TOD have enough stored documentation, but implementation often starts without retrieving project history, known-good solutions, failed attempts, decisions, and regressions.

role_split.mim: Project Manager: find project history, summarize decisions, identify known-good solutions and failures, recommend next action.
role_split.tod: Engineering Lead: inspect related files/objectives/artifacts, check regressions and validation evidence, gate execution against duplicate or stale work.
role_split.codex: Specialist Engineer: implement after the continuity brief is loaded.

required_gate_questions: Has this project or problem been worked on before?
Is there a Studio Project record, objective, document, report, or artifact for it?
What files, scripts, routes, or services were previously changed?
What validation proved success or exposed failure?
What is the recommended next bounded action?
first_implementation_slice: build continuity lookup helper or endpoint
add Before We Continue summary shape
wire Studio chat or H.A.L. triage to run it before implementation-style requests
validate against forum graphics project history
success_criteria: new thread receives a continuity brief before implementation begins
brief includes previous fixes, known regressions, open issues, recommended next action, loaded documents/artifacts, and what not to redo
Codex starts from accumulated project knowledge instead of rediscovery
